words.gloss: those who can accomplish great deeds

literal: Not despising the power of those who can accomplish deeds, among all the protections of those who protect themselves, is the foremost.
translation: Not disregarding the power of those who can accomplish great deeds is the foremost of all safeguards for those who wish to protect themselves.
modern: காரியங்களைச் சாதிக்க வல்லவர்களின் ஆற்றலை இகழாமல் இருப்பது, தம்மைக் காக்க நினைப்பவர்கள் செய்யும் பாதுகாப்புகள் எல்லாவற்றிலும் முதன்மையானது ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme importance of self-preservation through respect. The word 'ஆற்றுவார்' refers to capable people who have the power to execute great tasks, and 'ஆற்றல்' is their inherent strength. The poet explains that for those who wish to guard themselves ('போற்றுவார்') from ruin, avoiding the disrespect or slighting ('இகழாமை') of such powerful individuals is the most vital ('தலை') of all protective measures ('போற்றலுள் எல்லாம்'). True safety begins not with physical fortresses, but with the wisdom of not provoking those who possess the power to act.
